row.notes: VEHICLE PERFORMANCE COMPARISON fill, called only by Game_Refresh_PerformanceComparison 0x141890990 for modes 0..3 (0x141890ae8, 0x141890b08, 0x141890b5a, 0x141890bac; rcx = rsi = the comparison) before the sort, the top-3 cut (mode 2), the 3-entry window around the player team (mode 3) and the tail jmp to the panel build 0x1418914f0; returns nothing. Zeroes the count +0x38, then walks the UpgradesComponent at +0x10 (models +0x298..+0x2a0) and appends at +0x40 + count*0x14, incrementing +0x38, with no check against the 20 slots. A team entry writes only +0 (team key = model +0xc) and +8 (f32 value) and keeps the refresh prefill {+0 0x3fff0000, +4 0x3fff0000, +8/+0xc/+0x10 0} elsewhere. Skips: with +0x1f5 set, a model for which 0x141895110(comparison, team key) is true; the +0x1f6 block (career [+8]+0xf08, its list +0x298 stride 0x30 matched to +0x2b0) only skips (0x1418911d2 jne 0x141890f00) and makes no entries. With +0x1f7 and the model key == +0x1d4/+0x1d6 (the player team) the entries are per driver from 0x143522910 (+4 driver key), each valued with its team's model. Value = the type metadata rating base sum (+0x1a38 entries +0xc; department +1 == +0x1d8 unless 5) plus 0x143518350 or 0x143518660 (the completed upgrades' share). The panel's rows stop at +0x38, but its player-reference lookup 0x14189157c-0x141891821 searches all 20 slots for +0x1d4/+0x1d6 whatever +0x38 says and feeds every row's +0xc delta and +0x10 ratio, so a wrap that removes entries after orig lowers +0x38 and refills the vacated slots with the prefill. EA: rva 0x188b3b0, called from the refresh 0x188aee0 at 0x188b038/0x188b058/0x188b0aa/0x188b0fc. Verifier corrections V9288 folded in.

verify.notes: V9289 Re-check of the corrected notes on d873a1c8. Matching statements: the 4 call sites with rcx = rsi; modes 0..3 before the sort, the mode 2 cut, the mode 3 window and the tail jmp; void; +0x38 zeroed then incremented per append at +0x40 + count*0x14 with no 20-slot check; a team entry writes only +0 (model +0xc) and +8 (f32) and keeps the prefill {+0 0x3fff0000, +4 0x3fff0000, +8/+0xc/+0x10 0} (0x141890a85-0x141890ac4); the +0x1f5 skip through 0x141895110(comparison, team key); the +0x1f6 block (career [+8]+0xf08, list +0x298 stride 0x30 matched to +0x2b0) only skips and adds no entries; per-driver entries for +0x1f7 with model key == +0x1d4/+0x1d6 from 0x143522910 with +4 = driver key, each valued with the model of the driver's team; the value is the rating base sum (+0x1a38 entries +0xc, department +1 == +0x1d8 unless 5) plus 0x143518350 (when 5) or 0x143518660; the panel's rows are bounded by +0x38 while its player-reference lookup 0x14189157c-0x141891821 searches all 20 slots and feeds +0xc/+0x10, so the refill advice is right; EA rva 0x188b3b0 called from 0x188b038/0x188b058/0x188b0aa/0x188b0fc in the refresh 0x188aee0.
